_doc: Lagu unit (SP 7.1.1-7.1.6), melodi lagu rakyat 'Bangau Oh Bangau' (soal jawab berantai). Suku kata ikut lagu asal: 'X oh X' (5) + 'kenapa ...' (7) / 'Macam mana aku ...' (9) + jawapan (6-7). Sebutan baku.
title: Paku Oh Paku
caption: slow gentle Malaysian children's song in the style of a classic Malay folk nursery rhyme (lagu kanak-kanak rakyat), sung in standard Malaysian Malay (sebutan baku), clear Malaysian diction, not Indonesian, {voice}, simple repetitive melody, easy for 7-year-olds to sing along, soft acoustic guitar, glockenspiel, light hand claps, warm and cheerful

voices.female: warm clear female voice, Malaysian kindergarten teacher
voices.male: friendly clear male voice, Malaysian primary school teacher

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Paku oh paku, kenapa kau melekat?
Macam mana aku tak lekat, magnet menarik besi

[Verse 2]
Pensel oh pensel, kenapa kau tak lekat?
Macam mana aku nak lekat, aku bukannya besi

[Verse 3]
Magnet oh magnet, kenapa kau menolak?
Macam mana aku tak tolak, kutub kita sama

[Verse 4]
Magnet oh magnet, kenapa kau menarik?
Macam mana aku tak tarik, kutub kita berlainan

[Verse 5]
Peti oh peti, kenapa pintu rapat?
Macam mana aku tak rapat, ada magnet di situ
